title: Statement of Appellant Rights under the Member Appeals Program
content:
While an appeal is open under the Member Appeals Program, the appellant has the rights set out below. The table shows, for each Northbridge Appeals package, whether each right applies.

| Right | Level One Delegated | Two-Level Delegated | Single-Level with External Review | Two-Level with External Review | State-Regulated Insured | Full Fiduciary Delegation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A. Free access to the case file and the criteria applied | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| B. New evidence or rationale relied on at appeal is sent before the decision | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| C. Ongoing therapy stays covered while the appeal is pending | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| D. An undecided appeal may be withdrawn | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| E. A withdrawn appeal may be refiled while the filing limit has not passed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Each column is the Northbridge Appeals package of that name.

## The rights stated in full

- **A. Case file.** The appellant may obtain the case file and the criteria free of charge.
- **B. New evidence.** Any new evidence or rationale relied on at appeal is sent to the appellant before the decision is made.
- **C. Continued coverage.** When an ongoing therapy's coverage has been reduced or ended, that therapy stays covered while an appeal of that decision is pending.
- **D. Withdrawal.** The appellant may withdraw an appeal that has not yet been decided.
- **E. Refiling.** A withdrawn appeal may be refiled, provided the filing limit has not passed.

## Points of reading

- These rights do not vary between packages. All six Northbridge Appeals packages grant every one of them.
- Rights D and E work together. An appeal that has not been decided may be withdrawn, and the same appeal may then be filed again, but only while the filing limit has not passed.
